edges.description: Constitutive BRAF activation drives sustained MEK/ERK signaling
BRAF V600E initiates a serrated precursor pathway with epigenetic silencing
ERK activation drives cell cycle progression and proliferation
ERK inhibition releases negative feedback on EGFR
MLH1 promoter methylation creates mismatch-repair deficiency in the MSI-H subset
The organoids carry the parental BRAF V600E driver landscape with high concordance, so the constitutive activation at the node is present in the model as it is in the tumour.
edges.limitations: Organoids lack stroma, vasculature and, except in the co-culture arm, immune cells; driver retention is a genomic readout rather than a direct measurement of BRAF kinase activity.

nodes.description: The V600E mutation substitutes glutamic acid for valine at position 600 in the activation segment of BRAF kinase. This mimics phosphorylation-induced activation, locking BRAF in an active conformation. The mutant kinase signals constitutively through MEK and ERK without upstream RAS activation.

nodes.description: Unlike melanoma, colorectal cancer cells have high EGFR expression. When BRAF is inhibited, relief of ERK-mediated negative feedback leads to rapid EGFR reactivation, which signals through RAS and CRAF to restore MAPK pathway activity. This explains why BRAF inhibitor monotherapy fails in colorectal cancer but works in melanoma.

nodes.description: Sustained ERK signaling promotes entry into the cell cycle by inducing cyclin D1 and other proliferative genes while suppressing cell cycle inhibitors. This drives continuous tumor cell division independent of external growth signals.

CIMP-high methylation silences MLH1 in part of this stratum, producing mismatch-repair deficiency and high microsatellite instability. Whether a given BRAF V600E tumor takes this branch is what separates the entry's two subtype rows: advanced serrated-pathway lesions diverge toward MLH1-methylated MSI-H/dMMR disease or MLH1-unmethylated MSS/pMMR disease. The branch is usually sporadic rather than Lynch syndrome-associated, and it creates a more immunogenic tumor phenotype that can respond to immune checkpoint blockade.

nodes.description: BRAF V600E-mutant CRC commonly develops through sessile serrated lesions rather than the classic APC-driven adenoma-carcinoma sequence. Constitutive MAPK signaling cooperates with widespread CpG island methylation to silence tumor suppressor loci, creating a CIMP-high intermediate state that can progress through either an MSI-H or MSS trajectory.

Constitutive BRAF V600E activation leads to continuous phosphorylation of MEK1/2, which phosphorylates ERK1/2. Activated ERK translocates to the nucleus and drives expression of genes promoting cell proliferation, survival, and invasion. This signaling is independent of growth factor receptor activation.
